scope: G02 description image sizing and links in the existing rich-text editor

sources.evidence: Description images support links and size settings. Linked official screenshot unavailable (HTTP 403); no exact visual equivalence claimed.
Description editor disables image drag resize and exposes image_link, image_unlink, image_size_25/50/75/100.
Image size commands use .25/.5/.75/1, image links reuse link dialog without display text and with isNewWindow option.

changes: Image selection exposes four width presets, image link and unlink through the existing shared dialog layer.
Existing link dialog also edits image link and new-window setting. Cancel leaves the original DOM unchanged; committed changes preserve native browser undo and adjacent content.
Shared HTML sanitization preserves validated positive px/% image widths and explicit same-window links while removing unsafe markup and unrelated styles.
No new editor, persistence mechanism, route or workflow behavior.

verified: Four width presets set 25%,50%,75%,100%; native undo restores prior unset width and retains one image.
Cancelled image link does not introduce an anchor. Applied link survives subsequent image resizing.
Unchecking new-window persists target=_self. Unlink preserves 50% width; native undo restores the same link and target.
Saved draft cold reload retains 50% width and https://example.com/specification target=_self.
Published V4 runtime image loads and renders 145px at 50%. At 390x844, popup bounds left62/right382/bottom836 remain inside viewport.
V4 record submitted with customer 图片设置验收客户 and child value 半宽图片 / 当前页链接. Cold reload and record edit retain the new record and image settings.

limits: Ordinary text-link display-text editing and new-window checkbox remain missing from the local normal-link dialog.
